scope: Completed full97 DEV only. Official per-sequence metrics are checked against unchanged scorer NPZ. Raw per-frame IoU uses saved predictions and unrounded float32 GT without GT clipping; it is a diagnostic, not official SR. Invalid GT excluded from raw diagnostics. Rule triggers are inferred from frame/confidence/source, not observed tensor-write events. Low-IoU queries do not establish harmful gains because primary pre-query boxes were not saved. Separate cost trajectories have different histories: differences are not same-state causal effects. Mixed device load precludes paired speedup inference. No active run/NN/weight reads.
